# TInterpreter pure virtuals implemented by hand in TCppInterOpInterpreter.cxx.
# Everything else gets a loud-failure override generated by gen_fatal.py.
#
# M3 scope: exactly what a P0 TH1D program calls, as measured by
# wasm/gates/rootlight/interp-probe. M4 adds the TFormula/TMethodCall surface.
Initialize
RegisterModule
ShutDown

# M4: what TFormula and TMethodCall call to compile and invoke a formula.
# The ClassInfo_/CallFunc_ handle methods below are non-pure, but are overridden
# by hand because ROOT's base-class defaults for them are silent no-ops.
Declare
ProcessLine
ProcessLineSynch
Calc
ClassInfo_Factory
CallFunc_SetFuncProto
CheckClassInfo

# Family A (genuine, supersedes the earlier S0 throwaway): mirrors
# TCling::SetClassInfo (TCling.cxx:4154-4269), writing the real cl->fClassInfo
# via the TClass.h friend patch (see host-rootcling.patch).
SetClassInfo

# Genuinely truthful state (not measurement-only): a plain bool tracks the
# auto-parsing-suspended flag for TInterpreter::SuspendAutoParsing's RAII
# contract (TInterpreter.h:64,111-118; TClass.cxx:3076-3083).
SetSuspendAutoParsing
IsAutoParsingSuspended

# Family 0 (genuine): parses a class's header(s) on demand from the same
# classname->header table ROOT's own generated dictionaries hand to
# RegisterModule (TCling.cxx:2275-2313; TInterpreter.h:144). Returns 1/0 per
# TCling::AutoParse's own documented contract (TCling.cxx:6641-6643).
AutoParse

# Family A (genuine): the ClassInfo_t <-> DeclId_t identity round trip
# SetClassInfo needs for TClass::AddClassToDeclIdMap. Only the ClassInfo_t
# overload is genuinely implemented; the other 5 GetDeclId overloads are
# declared as explicit loud overrides in the header (MethodInfo_t/
# DataMemberInfo_t/CallFunc_t/FuncTempInfo_t/TypedefInfo_t reflection is out of
# this task's scope).
GetDeclId

# Non-pure TInterpreter virtuals overridden by hand. ROOT's base class gives
# these silent inline defaults, so they must be named here or gen_fatal.py would
# redeclare them. Overloads of these names that are NOT supported are declared
# explicitly in the header and call rkUnsupported, so skipping the name never
# reintroduces a silent default.
ClassInfo_Init
ClassInfo_Delete
ClassInfo_IsValid
CallFunc_Factory
CallFunc_Init
CallFunc_Delete
CallFunc_IsValid
CallFunc_IFacePtr

# Fix 2 (M4b, discovered empirically): TPluginManager::AddHandler
# (TPluginManager.cxx:568-579) calls this on every macro-driven plugin
# registration; ROOT's own base class default (TInterpreter.h:259) is
# `return nullptr`, kept as-is here rather than fabricating real macro-name
# tracking. See the header comment for how this was found (an instrumented
# build showed AddHandler throwing mid-JIT before fHandlers->Add(h) ran).
GetCurrentMacroName

# Genuine (if narrower than ROOT's own): the class's doc comment via
# Cpp::GetDoxygenComment, TClass.cxx:1185/1583's TClass ctor and Init reload
# path. Only one overload exists (TInterpreter.h:438), so no sibling override
# is needed. See TCppInterOpInterpreter::ClassInfo_Title for why this differs
# from TClingClassInfo::Title's own annotate-attribute/GetClassComment path.
ClassInfo_Title

# Fix 3 (M4b, discovered empirically): TClass::GetClass(ClassInfo_t*, Bool_t)
# (TClass.cxx:3425) needs this for TBaseClass::GetClassPointer()'s lookup of a
# base's TClass by name. Genuine via Cpp::GetQualifiedName, same convention
# as ClassInfo_Title/BaseClassInfo_FullName.
ClassInfo_FullName

# M4b, discovered mid-task (not in the original family list): the method-lookup
# path TClass::GetMethodWithPrototype actually goes through
# (TListOfFunctions::Get, TListOfFunctions.cxx:320-324) checks this before ever
# building a TMethod. Genuine via Cpp::GetParentScope's canonical-decl identity.
ClassInfo_Contains

# M4b Family B (genuine): method-handle factories/enumeration over
# Cpp::GetClassMethods (single enumeration source). MethodInfo_Factory() (no
# args) is declared explicitly in the header as an unsupported sibling.
MethodInfo_Factory
MethodInfo_Next
MethodInfo_IsValid
MethodInfo_Delete
MethodInfo_FactoryCopy
MethodInfo_Name

# M4b Family C (genuine, narrower than TClingMethodInfo's own AST walk -- see
# TCppInterOpInterpreter.cxx for exactly which bits are covered).
MethodInfo_Property
MethodInfo_ExtraProperty
MethodInfo_NArg
MethodInfo_NDefaultArg

# M4b: same Cpp::GetDoxygenComment convention as ClassInfo_Title, required
# unconditionally by TFunction's own constructor (TFunction.cxx:43).
MethodInfo_Title

# M4b Family D (genuine): argument-handle factories/properties.
# MethodArgInfo_Factory() (no args) is declared explicitly in the header as an
# unsupported sibling. MethodArgInfo_TypeNormalizedName is the critical one
# TPluginHandler::CheckNameMatch (TPluginManager.cxx:179-191) compares --
# empirically verified against a host-side TClassEdit::GetNormalizedName probe,
# see STATE.md.
MethodArgInfo_Factory
MethodArgInfo_FactoryCopy
MethodArgInfo_Delete
MethodArgInfo_Next
MethodArgInfo_IsValid
MethodArgInfo_Name
MethodArgInfo_TypeName
MethodArgInfo_TypeNormalizedName
MethodArgInfo_DefaultValue
MethodArgInfo_Property

# M4b Family E (genuine): real overload resolution, replacing name-only lookup.
# TClass::GetMethodWithPrototype (TClass.cxx:4514-4535) is the caller.
GetFunctionWithPrototype

# M4b Family F (genuine, narrow -- only what TMethodCall's constructor-call
# path needs). CallFunc_SetFunc's two params-string sibling overloads and
# CallFunc_FactoryMethod are declared/left loud explicitly (a different, larger
# calling-convention family; CallFunc_FactoryMethod additionally confirmed
# unreached on this task's call chain, see STATE.md).
CallFunc_SetFunc
CallFunc_ExecWithArgsAndReturn

# Fix 2 (M4b, post-Family-F): the narrow ".X"-macro slice
# TPluginManager::LoadHandlerMacros needs -- declare the file, invoke its
# basename-named no-arg void function. Not TApplication::ExecuteFile's full
# ACLiC/argument grammar; see the header comment.
ExecuteMacro

# Fix 3 (M4b): CreateListOfBaseClasses (TClass.cxx:3721) and the narrow
# BaseClassInfo_* slice its own TBaseClass ctor/GetDelta() need, for a single
# non-virtual public base (Minuit2Minimizer's real shape). Genuine via
# Cpp::GetNumBases/GetBaseClass/GetBaseClassOffset. The two-arg
# BaseClassInfo_Factory overload and the onlyDirect BaseClassInfo_Next
# overload are declared/left loud explicitly in the header (a direct-pointing
# factory and an indirect-base query neither this task's call chain nor
# CppInterOp's own GetNumBases/GetBaseClass -- direct bases only -- need).
# BaseClassInfo_Property/_TmpltName/_Name/_Tagnum are left to gen_fatal.py's
# generated loud default: CppInterOp 1.9 has no per-base access-specifier or
# virtual-base predicate at all, so a real answer cannot be computed without
# guessing.
CreateListOfBaseClasses
BaseClassInfo_Factory
BaseClassInfo_Next
BaseClassInfo_Delete
BaseClassInfo_ClassInfo
BaseClassInfo_FullName
BaseClassInfo_Offset
